hard_disqualifier_text: KPMG AG's Independent Auditor's Report carries a dedicated section titled 'Material Uncertainty about the Ability of Subsidiaries to Continue as a Going Concern,' tied to Glovoapp Spain Platform S.L.U. and the ongoing Spanish social-security rider-classification investigation (contingent liability disclosed at EUR440-770 million). The report explicitly states the group-level opinions have not been modified in this regard.
